req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. Tests must verify: (1) positive - a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes; (2) negative - an invalid code in the list returns 400; (3) boundary - a single-item list (no comma) returns exactly that code; (4) weighted choices are parsed correctly; (5) the random selection covers all listed codes over many trials. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, testing both sides of the comma-detection branch, and verifying the set of possible outcomes exactly.

tests.name: test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Collect all distinct status codes returned
expected: Every response status code is one of {200, 301, 404}
No response returns a code outside that set
Over 100 trials, at least two distinct codes are observed (randomness check)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: comma-separated list triggers random selection
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
allowed = {200, 301, 404}
observed = set()
for _ in range(100):
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404')
    assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected code: {r.status_code}'
    observed.add(r.status_code)
assert len(observed) >= 2, f'Expected randomness across codes, got only {observed}'

def test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes():
    client2 = app.test_client()
    allowed2 = {200, 301, 404}
    observed2 = set()
    for _ in range(100):
        r = client2.get('/status/200,301,404')
        assert r.status_code in allowed2
        observed2.add(r.status_code)
    assert len(observed2) >= 2

def test_all_three_codes_eventually_selected():
    client = app.test_client()
    allowed = {200, 418, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(300):
